title: Lightning Jabber
summary: +1 spear adds Lightning damage in melee and when thrown. On hit it can block the target’s Reaction points.

fields.Damage: One hand or thrown: 1d6 + 1 Piercing. Two-handed melee: 1d8 + 1 Piercing. Add Strength to damage, +1 to attack rolls and 1d4 Lightning. The thrown Lightning applies even on a miss.
fields.Shocking Sting: On hit the target makes a hidden DC 13 Constitution save. Failure applies Shocking Grasp for 2 turns, preventing spending Reaction points. Reactions without that cost can still trigger.
fields.Handling: Simple Versatile spear, 5 ft melee. Thrown and Dippable. Dipping removes the surface used. It does not work with Polearm Master because BG3 internally tags it as a javelin.
fields.Rush Attack: Action, 30 ft. Charge and attack the first non-allied creature or object in the path for 1d4 + applicable ability modifier Piercing. A failed Strength save against weapon-action DC applies Off Balance for 2 turns. Once per Short Rest with proficiency.
fields.Acquisition: Loot the Cursed Kuo-Toa Chief northeast of the Grand Mausoleum entrance.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
